newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pengkalen Industrial planned buys nixed.
newsitem.headline: Pengkalen Industrial planned buys nixed.

text.p: Pengkalen Industrial Holdings Bhd said that its proposed acquisition of three companies, a rights issue and a special Bumiputera (ethnic Malay) issue have been rejected by the Securities Commission.
In a statement late on Tuesday, the company did not provide the reasons for the rejection by the market watchdog, but said its directors would appeal for a reconsideration of its decision.

Pengkalen Industrial makes footwear. It had previously proposed to acquire Choo Yeang Sdn Bhd, Choo Yeang Properties and Construction Sdn Bhd and a 28.78 percent stake in Labuan Securities Sdn Bhd. It had also proposed a one-for-one rights issue.
The company had sought to diversify its operations through the acquisitions, which would have taken it into property investment and development as well as stockbroking.
